headline: I rented it in summer and
it sat empty the rest.
Which return do I file?
bueno-rented-part-of-the-year.sub: You file both kinds, on the same form 210.
items: You declare the rent for the weeks it was let.
For the empty weeks, you declare an income worked out from the cadastral value.

headline: You can owe tax on a
home you never rent.
imputed-income-empty-home.sub: It's based on the cadastral value on your IBI bill, and nothing can be deducted from it.

bueno-year-end-return.headline: You file even if nobody rented it.
bueno-year-end-return.sub: Bueno files form 210 for you, starting from €50. Direct debit payments close earlier, on 23 December.

headline: Check the post
before the sums.
items: Filing on your own costs 1%, plus 1% for each full month late.
From month 13 it becomes a flat 15%, plus interest.
After a letter from the tax office, these rules no longer apply.

headline: I already pay IBI.
Is that my Spanish tax?
bueno-ibi-is-not-this.sub: No. Form 210 is a separate national return.
items: IBI is the local tax paid to your town hall.
Form 210 is national, and nobody sends you a bill.
It's worked out from the cadastral value on your IBI.
bueno-ibi-is-not-this.cta: We file it for you, from €50.

headline: The last quarterly return
is due by 20 October.
items: Rent from 1 October goes into one yearly return.
Your next filing after this is in April 2027.

headline: We own the place together.
So is that one return,
or one each?
bueno-two-owners-two-returns.sub: Each owner files their own form 210.
items: If you own half each, each return uses half the cadastral value.
Bueno files a form 210 for every owner, starting from €50.

headline: Same flat, same rent,
a different tax bill.
eu-eea-deductions.sub: In the EU and EEA you deduct costs and pay 19%. Elsewhere it's 24% on the gross rent.

bueno-what-goes-into-it.headline: Four details make up your return.
bueno-what-goes-into-it.sub: We need your cadastral value, your share and where you're tax resident. Bueno files it from €50.

headline: The 3% on a sale
is not the tax.
items: The buyer holds back 3% of the price and pays it on modelo 211.
Your real capital gains tax is 19% of the gain, for everyone.
If the 3% was more than you owe, the difference comes back to you.
three-percent-retention.cta: Work out your refund free at 247spain.es.

headline: Direct debit closes
on 23 December.
bueno-direct-debit-date.sub: Filing itself stays open until 31 December.
items: Direct debit stops eight days before filing does.
After that, you have to pay the tax another way.
It helps not to leave it for the last week.
bueno-direct-debit-date.cta: We file it for you, from €50.

headline: Plusvalia has two methods,
and you can pick the lower.
items: If there was no increase, there is nothing to pay.
You have thirty working days from the deed.

headline: Why does Bueno file my
return from €50 when I
was quoted a few hundred?
bueno-why-from-fifty.sub: Very little changes from one year to the next.
items: We store last year's form and use it to draft this year's.
The price depends on the number of owners, so a couple is two returns.

headline: It depends on services,
not the length of stay.
iva-holiday-let.sub: With no services, a holiday let is exempt. Hotel type services during the stay make it 10%.

bueno-included-in-select.headline: On Select, it is already included.
bueno-included-in-select.sub: Select is €199 a year and covers up to two owners and two properties. On Standard, filing starts from €50.

headline: What does my
home cost a year?
items: The bills arrive one by one, from six or seven places.
No single bill gets a morning of anyone's attention.
Put the whole year in one column and compare it.

headline: Never filed? It can
still be put right.
bueno-never-filed.sub: Filing before the tax office asks keeps it to a surcharge.
items: It starts at 1% plus 1% per full month.
From month 13, it is a flat 15% plus interest.
The surcharge takes the place of a penalty.
bueno-never-filed.cta: Tell us the years and we will quote.

headline: Mortgage from 2000 to 2019?
The costs are worth a read.
items: Some set up fees were charged to the borrower.
Whether a claim is still in time needs an abogado.

headline: I file my own return.
What changes on form 210
from January 2027?
bueno-form-changes-2027.sub: It gets new fields and a later window.
items: It will ask for the days available and your ownership percentage.
The 2026 return opens on 1 April 2027 and runs to 31 December.

headline: Your home policy may
pay for your lawyer.
legal-cover-you-already-pay-for.sub: Look for defensa juridica. You have the right to choose your own lawyer.

ninety-days.big_label: You can stay for up to
ninety-days.headline: That is in any rolling 180 days.
ninety-days.sub: The day you land and the day you fly home both count. A long weekend uses four days, not two.

headline: After a storm,
who do I phone?
items: Some damage is paid by the Consorcio, not your insurer.
Wind counts once gusts pass 120 km an hour over three seconds.
The surcharge is already collected with your premium.

headline: I missed the meeting.
How long do I have?
community-decision-clock.sub: You have three months, or a year if it breaks the law.
items: If you were absent, the clock starts when you were told.
Keep the envelope or email with its date on it.
Usually you must be up to date with community payments.

headline: My builder sent a quote.
What should it say?
items: It should give a start date and a finish date.
Payments should follow stages of the work.

headline: I'm locking up for winter.
What do I need to do
before I leave?
leaving-it-empty.sub: It depends on three things, not on its size.
items: How long you're away and the season you leave in both change the list.
So does whether anyone will look in while you're gone.

headline: Utilities are five jobs,
and the order matters.
utilities-in-order.sub: Start the wrong one first and you wait. The NIE application is form EX-15, and the fee is €9.84.

tradesperson-in-your-language.big_label: Find trades in your language in
tradesperson-in-your-language.headline: Reviews in your language lead.
tradesperson-in-your-language.sub: Plumbers, electricians, locksmiths and builders are ranked from reviews. It is free, and nobody pays to rank higher.

headline: Four titles that
are not one job.
items: An abogado is a lawyer and runs your case.
A gestoría handles filings and paperwork, and does not go to court.
An administrador de fincas runs the community of owners.
who-does-what.cta: See who does what free at 247spain.es.

headline: Maintenance is a calendar,
not a list of jobs.
maintenance-is-a-year.sub: The same job in the wrong month prevents nothing.
items: Sun, salt and winter break different things.
They break them at different times of year.
Some jobs must happen while you are away.

headline: Which pests should I
expect at my place?
items: Heat, gardens and empty months attract different pests.
Some pests are a phone call, not a Saturday job.
